def _snapshot_layers(ab, bc, ac, forbidden, k):
    forbidden_set = set(tuple(t) for t in forbidden)
    per_b = []
    for b in range(k):
        row_sums = [ab[a][b] for a in range(k)]
        col_sums = [bc[b][c] for c in range(k)]
        upper = [[0 if (a, b, c) in forbidden_set else ac[a][c]
